nodes.title: SG-8.5 Unit tests for ContributionSheet with the API client mocked
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet (game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx) already implements submit, history, validation and Radix dialog focus behaviour, with many partial suites in game/frontend/tests. Desired behavior: four focused test files exist and pass, covering submit success, API error, quota exhausted, history loading/empty/error/list, empty and over-length validation, Escape, focus trap and focus restore. Expected result: each behaviour is asserted by a named test. Why: SG-8.5 requires the test files to actually exist and pass.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the API is mocked, when a submit succeeds, fails with 500 or fails with 409, then each outcome is asserted by a test that passes
- Given the history endpoint is mocked, when it is pending, empty, failing or returns entries, then each state is asserted by a test that passes
- Given empty and 501-character text, when Send is attempted, then the validation tests assert no POST is made
- Given an open dialog, when Escape is pressed, focus moves outside or the dialog closes, then the Escape, focus trap and focus restore tests pass


## Scope
- In scope: Test ids on existing ContributionSheet elements
- In scope: Four new vitest files under game/frontend/tests
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Browser or e2e tests
- Out of scope: Changing user-visible text or behaviour
- Preserve: Existing contribution tests
- Preserve: API client contracts in game/frontend/src/api/client.ts


## Technical constraints
- vitest with jsdom and mocked fetch
- No real network


## Definition of done
- All four new test files pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Submit success, API error and quota exhausted outcomes are individually identifiable
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet shows success via data-testid contribution-success, but the error alert and the quota-used message have no test ids. Desired behavior: the error alert and zero-quota message carry test ids. Expected result: tests assert success, 500 error, 409 error and quota exhausted separately. Why: SG-8.5 submit coverage.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a 201 response, when Send is clicked, then contribution-success shows 'Suggestion sent'
- Given a 500 response, when Send is clicked, then contribution-error shows 'Could not send'
- Given a 409 response, when Send is clicked, then contribution-error shows 'Limit reached or duplicate idea'
- Given 5 sent contributions in history, when the sheet opens, then contribution-quota is shown and Send is disabled


## Scope
- In scope: Test ids for error and quota alerts
- Out of scope: Message wording changes
- Preserve: Existing text, roles and ids


## Technical constraints
- Keep role=alert on both elements


## Definition of done
- Test ids present and submit tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · History loading, empty, error and list states are identifiable and asserted
nodes.body:
Context: loading, empty and error messages have test ids; the list does not. Desired behavior: the history list carries a test id. Expected result: tests assert loading, empty, error with Retry and populated list. Why: SG-8.5 history coverage.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a pending history request, when the sheet opens, then contribution-history-loading is shown
- Given an empty history, when it loads, then contribution-history-empty is shown
- Given a failing history request, when it settles, then contribution-history-error and a Retry button are shown
- Given two past suggestions, when history loads, then contribution-history-list contains both prompts marked Sent


## Scope
- In scope: Test id on the suggestions list
- Out of scope: Changes to loading logic
- Preserve: aria-label 'Your suggestions'


## Definition of done
- History tests pass

- None

nodes.title: REQ · Empty and over-length text are rejected with identifiable messages
nodes.body:
Context: blank and over-limit alerts exist with ids but no test ids. Desired behavior: add test ids; tests assert messages and absence of POST. Why: SG-8.5 validation coverage.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given empty text, when the form is submitted, then contribution-validation-blank shows 'Enter an idea first' and no POST is made
- Given 501 characters, when typed, then contribution-validation-limit shows 'Too long: 501 / 500', Send is disabled and no POST is made
- Given exactly 500 characters, when sent, then contribution-validation-limit is absent and POST is made


## Scope
- In scope: Test ids on validation alerts
- Out of scope: Limit changes
- Preserve: MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH 500


## Definition of done
- Validation tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Escape, focus trap and focus restore are asserted for the dialog
nodes.body:
Context: Radix Dialog supplies Escape and focus trap; onCloseAutoFocus restores focus to returnFocusRef. Desired behavior: Close button has a test id; tests assert the three behaviours directly on ContributionSheet. Why: SG-8.5 keyboard coverage.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given an open sheet, when Escape is pressed, then onClose is called once
- Given a button outside the dialog, when it is focused while the sheet is open, then focus returns inside the dialog
- Given returnFocusRef points at a trigger, when the sheet closes, then the trigger has focus


## Scope
- In scope: Test id on Close button
- Out of scope: Changing Radix behaviour
- Preserve: onCloseAutoFocus logic


## Definition of done
- Keyboard tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
